overview: You set Quiney's name, the certificate, and tonight on the tables, and you wrote nothing under them. No sum is on the leaf.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the three words, and stopped.

parties.name: Richard Quiney
parties.context: Named, and not yet written to.
